text: 1. Cattār'; imāni bhikkhave pañhavyākaraṇāni. Katamāni cattāri? Atthi bhikkhave pañho ekaṃsavyākaraṇīyo, atthi bhikkhave pañho paṭipucchā-vyākaraṇīyo, atthi bhikkhave pañho ṭhapanīyo, atthi bhikkhave pañho vibhajjavyākaraṇīyo. Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri pañhavyākaraṇānīti. 2. Ekaṃsa-vacanaṃ ekaṃ vibhajja-vacanaṃ paraṃ Tatiyaṃ paṭipuccheyya catuttham pana ṭhāpaye Yo ca tesaṃ tattha tattha jānāti anudhammataṃ Catu pañhassa kusalo āhu bhikkhuṃ tathāvidhaṃ Durāsado duppasaho gambhīro duppadhaṃsiyo Atho atthe anatthe ca ubhayassa hoti kovido Anatthaṃ parivajjeti atthaṃ gaṇhāti paṇḍito Atthābhisamayā dhūro paṇḍito ti pavuccatīti. 43.
